author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, finding C, echoing short patterns, spotting lines that come twice and taking turns, with an old French wake-up song.

classes.title: Everything comes twice
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and notice that every line is sung two times.

mathTarget.parentLine: Every line is sung once, then the same line again

classes.parentPrompt: Sway together; hold up one finger for each line, then two when it repeats.
classes.childAction: Sway, and show two fingers when a line comes again.
classes.bridge: Each line knocks twice on Brother John's door: knock, knock.

intro.caption: Rock like a sleepy bell
intro.parentCue: sit together and sway side to side

intro.caption: Does it come again? Two!
intro.parentCue: Hold up two fingers when a line repeats

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing lines that come two times.

classes.title: Tick-tock, wake up!
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rock side to side like a clock first, then tap the keys together.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every tick of the clock.
classes.bridge: The beat is the bedroom clock: tick, tock, tick, tock, never in a hurry.

intro.caption: Tap with the circle
intro.parentCue: Rock like a clock together, tick, tock

games.caption: Tick-tock clock taps
games.parentCue: Tap with your child, one tap per beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find Brother John's C
classes.goal: Find C on the piano by touch, just left of the two black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a signpost to find C

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the two black keys together, then slide left to the white key C.
classes.childAction: Find two black keys, slide left, press C like a button.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are the bed; C sleeps just to the left of it.

intro.caption: Where does C live?
intro.parentCue: Touch the two black keys together first

games.caption: C, C, C: one, two, three
games.parentCue: Count out loud with each press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C by the two black keys.

classes.title: Climb out of bed
classes.goal: Listen to a 3 note call from the song, then copy it back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding three sounds in mind, then playing them back

classes.parentPrompt: Play the call, then hold your hands in your lap while your child answers.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then play it back the same.
classes.bridge: Three steps up to the right, like climbing out of bed: C, D, E.

intro.caption: Listen, then echo me
intro.parentCue: Stretch up together like waking in the morning

games.caption: Wake-up steps: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Point to each lit key, nice and slow

games.caption: Brother John: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Sing 'Brother John' with the three notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying three notes.

classes.title: Knock, knock, again!
classes.goal: Echo a short pattern, then play it a second time, just like the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same little tune two times in a row

classes.parentPrompt: After the first pattern, knock twice on the piano lid and say 'again!'
classes.childAction: Echo the little tune, then play it once more.
classes.bridge: Up the steps and back to C, then the very same walk again.

intro.caption: Listen, then echo me
intro.parentCue: Knock twice and say 'again!' when it repeats

games.caption: C, D, E, C, and again!

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a pattern two times.

classes.title: Ring the C bell
classes.goal: Wait and play C at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your turn, then playing exactly then

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys, including the low 'dang'; nod just before each coral C.
classes.childAction: Hands in your lap, then ring C when it lights up.
classes.bridge: Ding is your C; dang is the grown-up's low note; dong is C again.

intro.caption: Ring the C bell
intro.parentCue: Hands in laps until the coral C lights

games.caption: Ding, dang, dong bells
games.parentCue: Sing ding, dang, dong with the lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing C.

classes.title: Sleepy C, bell E
classes.goal: Listen and play the right one of two notes, C or E, in the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing which of two sounds it is, then choosing its key

classes.parentPrompt: Touch C and say 'sleepy', touch E and say 'bell', then play.
classes.childAction: Play C or E, whichever key lights up.
classes.bridge: C is left of the two black keys, E is right; the black keys sit between.

intro.caption: Listen for C and E
intro.parentCue: Touch C, then E, saying their names

games.caption: Ringing, ringing: E, C, E, C
games.parentCue: Say 'ring' on E and 'shh' on C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling C and E apart.

classes.title: Morning bells together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, each with your own notes, on a shared beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Nod the beat before you start; keep playing even if a note is missed.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Two bell ringers, one bell tower: we ring on the same beat.

intro.caption: Play it together
intro.parentCue: Nod the beat together before you start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing together on one shared beat.

classes.title: Wake up, teddy!
classes.goal: Play the whole song for a sleeping teddy, then wake teddy up and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Lay teddy down asleep; after the last 'dong', sit teddy up to clap.
classes.childAction: Play for sleeping teddy; on the last bell, teddy wakes up!
classes.bridge: The song starts in bed and ends with the bells: ding, dang, dong.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Lay teddy down, pretending to sleep

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
